description: Prediction of failure modes, strength, and deformation capacity of RC shear walls through machine learning is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Haoyou Zhang, Marquette University (marquette.edu). • The performance of ML algorithms in predicting the seismic behavior of RC wallmachine l is studied. • ML model developed in this study predict the strength of RC wall more accurate and efficient. • A brief boundary that separate flexure-shear failure from other failure modes is provided. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (XLSX). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-a7qt-h765. Keywords: machine learning, reinforced concrete shear walls, failure modes, strength capacity, deformation capacity. Published 2024-09-26. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
